title: Approval of TRICARE Prime Requests After the Military Clinic's Response Window, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When a TRICARE Prime request under **Referrals and Authorizations** of a type whose military clinic has the right of first refusal is still submitted after the clinic's response window has passed with no answer, and it duplicates no approved, unexpired authorization of the patient, the region approves it to the requested network provider.

## Conditions of the approval

- For a TRICARE Prime request, the patient holds an active TRICARE Prime enrollment on the request date.
- A request that would duplicate an approved, unexpired authorization of the same type for the same patient and the same servicing provider is not approved under this rule: it is denied as a duplicate request and the patient is pointed to the authorization already on file, as the duplicate rule requires.
- A patient holds only one open inpatient mental health authorization at a time, whatever the facility, because a patient is an inpatient of one psychiatric facility at a time.
- A pending inpatient mental health request is not approved until every other inpatient mental health authorization of the patient with a different servicing provider whose validity span is still running shows as cancelled or exhausted.

Restated for the inpatient mental health case: while another Inpatient Mental Health Authorization of the patient, at a different servicing provider and with its validity span still running, shows a status other than cancelled or exhausted, the pending inpatient mental health request is not approved.

## What the approval records

- The request's status changes from submitted to approved, with today as its decision date.
- Its validity span and units authorized are set, and its units remaining are set to the units authorized.
- One grant entry on the basis of an initial approval is added to its unit history.
- The patient, authorization type and servicing provider named in the call are the ones on the request, and are recorded unchanged.

## Invocation

The tool is `approve_pending_authorization_775ce183`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the submitted request being approved, as returned by the referral and authorization lookup for the patient | identifier, as returned |
| `customer_id` | the beneficiary reference number of the patient the request is for, as returned by the profile lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `variant_name` | the authorization type on the request | exactly one of the seven names listed below |
| `servicing_provider_id` | the provider directory reference number of the servicing provider on the request, as returned by the referral and authorization lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `valid_from` | the first day of the validity span | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `valid_through` | the last day of the validity span, inclusive | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `units_authorized` | the units approved, in the authorization's own unit of measure | whole number, 0 or more |

The values of `variant_name` are: Specialty Care Referral (a PCM referral to a specialist); Rehabilitative Therapy Referral (a PCM referral for therapy visits); Durable Medical Equipment Authorization (equipment rental months); Home Health Care Authorization (home visits for a homebound patient); Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization (ABA hours); Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization (skilled nursing facility days); Inpatient Mental Health Authorization (inpatient psychiatric days).

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `grant_entry_id` (the reference number of the new grant entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the request approved), `status` (reading "approved" once recorded), `valid_from` and `valid_through` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `units_authorized`.
